_comment: The Plan Your Event estimator. Numbers come from the 2026 Event Sales Kit and are the SAME ones published on the private events page — that file is the customer-facing menu, this one drives the maths. The build fails if they drift. Food is priced per person by DURATION; the bar is priced per person PER HOUR, so duration multiplies it. The kit publishes no 4h+ food rate, so that duration quotes rather than inventing one.

intro.heading: Build your estimate
intro.lead: Four short steps and you will have a price to work from. Nothing is booked and no card is needed — a real person reviews every estimate before anything is confirmed.

venue._comment: Captured, not costed. The sales kit prices buyouts and room rentals with a food-and-beverage minimum that interacts with the packages, and prints "prices may vary" beside them — so the coordinator quotes the space and the estimator stays honest about what it can compute.

_pricing_comment: guests x (food rate for the chosen duration + bar rate per hour x hours), then service on top. Checked against the kit's own worked example: 12 guests, 2 hours, Signature Smash and Courtside = 12 x ($55 + $16) = $852, +20% = $1,022, and the kit prints "from ~$1,000".
addonsNote: Add-ons are priced on inquiry and are not included in the figure above.

_receive_comment: Describe only what happens on its own. The site is static with no backend, so it cannot email anyone a summary — an earlier version promised one and that promise depended entirely on a human remembering.

swag._comment: Quoted, like every other add-on — the panel captures what they want in the bag, not what it costs. Nothing here feeds the total.
